description: Store one reading for a device, exactly as POST /add/{device} would. Useful for testing a dashboard or integration before hardware exists, or for writing to a channel a device listens to. One message per device per 30 s, shared with the device itself; everything is public.

device.description: Device name, e.g. amber-otter-4821. Letters, digits, '_', '.', '-'; max 64.

metrics.description: Flat object of 1-10 metrics, e.g. {"temp": 21.5, "hum": 60}. Values are numbers or short strings.

name: publish_reading
title: Send a reading
